text: “Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, O royal house! This judgment is against you: You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
I will discipline all of them.
Israel is not hidden from me. Ephraim, you have now turned to prostitution; Israel is corrupt.
